# package remote

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-opcua/pubsub/remote"
```

Package remote configures the PubSub of an OPC UA server through the methods of its PublishSubscribe information model (Part 14 §9): AddConnection, AddWriterGroup, AddDataSetWriter, AddReaderGroup, AddDataSetReader, AddPublishedDataItems, their Remove counterparts and the Enable and Disable methods of the PubSubStatus objects.

It works with any server that implements the model: the methods are looked up by BrowseName below the object they are called on, so both the NodeIds of the type's method declarations (open62541, this module's server) and instance method nodes are found.

## Variables

```go
var (
	// PublishSubscribe is the PublishSubscribe object (i=14443); it is the
	// component of the runtime itself for Enable, Disable and State.
	PublishSubscribe = ua.NewNumericNodeID(0, id.PublishSubscribe)
	// PublishedDataSets is the folder of the published data sets.
	PublishedDataSets = ua.NewNumericNodeID(0, id.PublishSubscribePublishedDataSets)
)
```

Well-known nodes of the PublishSubscribe object.

```go
var PubSubConfiguration = ua.NewNumericNodeID(0, id.PublishSubscribePubSubConfiguration)
```

PubSubConfiguration is the PubSubConfiguration file object of the PublishSubscribe object (Part 14 §9.1.3.7).

## Functions

### func Ref

```go
func Ref(op, kind ua.PubSubConfigurationRefMask, connection, group, element uint16) *ua.PubSubConfigurationRefDataType
```

Ref returns the reference of an element operation of UpdateConfiguration: op is ua.PubSubConfigurationRefMaskElementAdd, Match, Modify or Remove (Add and Match may be combined), kind one of the Reference bits, and the indices locate the element in the configuration written.

#### func (Client) UpdateConfiguration

```go
func (r *Client) UpdateConfiguration(ctx context.Context, cfg *ua.PubSubConfiguration2DataType, refs []*ua.PubSubConfigurationRefDataType, requireComplete bool) (*UpdateResult, error)
```

UpdateConfiguration writes cfg to the PubSubConfiguration file and applies the element operations of refs with CloseAndUpdate (Part 14 §9.1.3.7.6). With requireComplete the server applies the changes only if it can apply all of them.
